public_only_action_policy: original unmodified MR26 BoundedPublicNoveltyExplorer seeded per ORIGINAL reset; actor sees only original full 7x7x3 public image
individual_receiver_cell_own_context: original 3 public uint8 tile bytes, one genuine prior native MR15 public-change bit (one-step local history), original preselected native action; no private pose/grid identities
added_information_treatments: ring donors i-1 and i+1: two original public 3-byte tile triplets + each donor previous native delta bit
skip three donors i-3 and i+3: same two triplets and prior public delta bits
permuted-control donors from cyclic order [0,2,4,6,1,3,5,7], excluding self: same two triplets and prior public delta bits
all-public original 7x7x3 uint8 image as a broader conventional whole-camera-view context, hashed at fixed key size but not matched effective information or camera corrected
controls: own local public context and action only; per receiver/action global Laplace; ring donors; skip-three; fixed permuted; full public view
estimators: All per-cell conventional online context-count predictors use exactly 128 FIFO 32-byte context-hash entries per original receiving cell; each entry two uint32-equivalent integer counts (trials,changed). Each per-cell action-specific global prior gets original public data. Candidate and control same cache capacity, prior pseudo count 4.
prospective_eval: Train online only in already consumed development source seeds. Freeze ALL learned count associations before any newly frozen evaluation seed; ephemeral true prior public-delta bits continue from real native steps; original source actor stays independently public-only.
information_readout: Prequential proper mean Brier and log-loss on native source next eight public delta target bits, comparisons paired per original native seed. Separate original actions 0/1/2 camera-motion from original actions 3/4/5 stationary public interventions.
preregistered_minimum: ring donor reduces held-out Brier by >=0.001 versus own-only and by >=0.001 versus skip-three and permuted donors in BOTH original source worlds
ring donor advantage over own-only on at least four of six independent native evaluation seeds per source world
for camera-stationary actions, >=16 original positive changed outcomes per source family, and ring must lower loss vs own-only there
no trained-context table adaptations during new dev evaluation
same maximum context cache capacity and 32-byte hashed lookup keys across all local-context models
note_on_comparators: Global and whole-public predictors are conventional controls but finite bounded count estimators; full public is not camera-corrected, and 128-entry hashed contexts are not expressive or sufficient statistics. A negative cannot prove zero conditional mutual information.
source_input_memory_truth: MR15 original 24 raw bytes plus 8 prior bits unchanged; S3 separate evaluator's eight per-cell count caches are NOT native 45-weight learning memory; count their entire footprint and do not claim original candidate 45-parameter parity
communication_budget: informational shadow reads two three-byte neighbor public triplets and two prior bits per cell (up to 8 unencoded public bytes/cell/action); no physical edge network is executed, so physical wire remains unqualified
